label: AT-MC102XL 100TX to 100FX media converter (SC, MM, 2 km)
description: Unmanaged Fast Ethernet converter with one 100BASE-TX RJ45 port and one duplex SC multimode fibre port at 1310 nm reaching 2 km. No IP stack and no management - it just forwards frames between the copper and fibre sides (and can be racked in an MCR12 chassis).
